description: Sends a prompt for the agent to process and respond to.

researchLinks.description: Detecting AWS Bedrock Abuse: From LLMjacking to the Hidden Attack Vectors

securityImplications: Attackers might use InvokeAgent to run a Bedrock agent (including one they have hijacked) to perform actions or extract data; the call is a CloudTrail data event that is not logged by default.
